items.basis: Factories Act 1948 s.51/54 (now OSH Code 2020): 48 h/week, 8 h/day, 6 days -> 312 paid working days (26/month x 12). Labour: fullyLoadedInrPerHr = 12 x (gross + employer PF/EDLI/admin + ESI + statutory bonus + gratuity) / 2,264 productive h. Statutory loading is +6.7% (engineer) to +16.3% (ESI-covered operators); leave/holidays add a further 10.2% through the hours.

Not loaded (no source found): night/3rd-shift allowance, canteen/transport/uniform, group insurance for non-ESI staff, contract-agency service charge, ex-gratia bonus above 8.33%. Fully-loaded figures are therefore a floor; customary items in tier-1 plants could plausibly add 10-25% but that range is NOT sourced and is not used.

Current book vs evidence (INR/h fully loaded): skilled 653.81 vs 161.8 (~4.0x high); semi-skilled 447.74 vs 114.1 (~3.9x); foundry 384.14 vs 129.5 (~3.0x); electronics 576.22 vs 137.8 (~4.2x); inspector 704.69 vs 123.3; technician 718.68 vs 143.8; supervisor 882.77 vs 196.7; engineer 1536.58 vs 254.6 (~6x). Even at the top of each band and with an unsourced +25% for customary items the book stays 2-4x too high.
